newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates close mixed.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates close mixed.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed mixed on Wednesday owing to increased buying of fine cotton by spinners, brokers said.
They said rates were likely to open mixed on higher buying on Thursday ahead of Friday's weekend closure of the market.
In the kerb market, the rate for the NIAB-78 variety rose to 2,075 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) from Tuesday's 2,050, plus 10 percent sales tax, broker Adil Nasim said.
"The rates will move both ways in the next few days owing to increased buying by spinners and dumping by farmers at ginneries," one dealer said.
